VsShareQuotedPct.meaning: share of the running slice's var-swap integral accrued on the quoted span (%)

VsShareBeyondPct.meaning: share accrued beyond the quoted span (%)

VsShareGalleryMinPct.meaning: smallest beyond-quotes share across the 16 frozen nodes (%)

VsShareGalleryMaxPct.meaning: largest beyond-quotes share across the 16 frozen nodes (%)

VsRayAtLim.meaning: B(k, 2 k) at k = 400 (tends to 1/2; the second Black term dies only like 1/sqrt(k) on the boundary ray)

WingEnvKbar.meaning: last quoted call-side log-moneyness on the running node

WingEnvCbar.meaning: normalized call at the last quote (of forward)

WingEnvKzero.meaning: log-moneyness where the lower envelope edge reaches zero

WingEnvTopAgree.meaning: closed-form upper edge vs production inversion at k = 30 (total variance)

WingEnvTopSlopeDeep.meaning: upper-edge slope dw+/dk at k = 30 (heads to 2)

WingEnvClearLqdLo.meaning: min clearance of the LQD wing above its own cone's lower edge

WingEnvClearLqdHi.meaning: min clearance of the LQD wing below its own cone's upper edge

WingEnvClearSviLo.meaning: min clearance of the SVI wing above its own cone's lower edge

WingEnvClearSviHi.meaning: min clearance of the SVI wing below its own cone's upper edge

WingEnvClearMcsLo.meaning: min clearance of the MCS wing above its own cone's lower edge

WingEnvClearMcsHi.meaning: min clearance of the MCS wing below its own cone's upper edge

WingBetaLqdL.meaning: LQD left (put) asymptotic total-variance wing slope

WingBetaLqdR.meaning: LQD right (call) asymptotic total-variance wing slope

WingBetaSviL.meaning: SVI left (put) asymptotic total-variance wing slope

WingBetaSviR.meaning: SVI right (call) asymptotic total-variance wing slope

WingBetaMcsL.meaning: MCS left (put) asymptotic total-variance wing slope

WingBetaMcsR.meaning: MCS right (call) asymptotic total-variance wing slope

WingHatSlopeDiff.meaning: measured realized wing-slope change from adding the hat (far-field finite difference at |k| = 8)

WingHatGmin.meaning: worst Durrleman factor after the hat

WingHatBaseGmin.meaning: worst Durrleman factor of the fitted slice on the same range

VsTermSpySpreadBp.meaning: largest SPY fair-strike spread over ATM vol (vol bp)

VsTermNvdaSpreadBp.meaning: largest NVDA fair-strike spread over ATM vol (vol bp)

VsTermIncMinVarBp.meaning: smallest adjacent-expiry increment of w_vs across both names (variance bp)

VsTermFwdVolMinPct.meaning: smallest SPY forward variance between expiries, as a forward vol (%)

VsThreeSvsPct.meaning: running slice fair var-swap vol, strike-side replication (%)

VsAgreeRankBp.meaning: law-side closed form vs strike-side replication (vol bp)

VsFieldSvsPct.meaning: SPY sheet fair var-swap vol at the running expiry, field side (%)

VsAgreeFieldBp.meaning: field-side backward solve vs the sheet's own strike-side replication, time step refined 8x (vol bp)

VsLvGapBp.meaning: sheet vs running slice fair-strike gap (vol bp) — the identifiability gap

VsAgreeFieldCoarseBp.meaning: the same two reads at the march's own time step (vol bp)

VsPinsNQuotes.meaning: prepared quotes on the running SPY December 2026 node

VsPinsLqdPct.meaning: LQD fair var-swap vol on the running node (%)

VsPinsSviPct.meaning: SVI fair var-swap vol on the running node (%)

VsPinsMcsPct.meaning: MCS fair var-swap vol on the running node (%)

VsPinsMaxGapBp.meaning: largest pairwise fair-strike gap across families (vol bp)

VsPinsBellyAgreeBp.meaning: worst pairwise IV distance on the quoted span (vol bp)

VsPinsWorstRmsBp.meaning: worst per-family rms fit error on the node (vol bp)
